name: Tipo de Comprobante de Pago o Documento (PLE tabla 10)
source: SUNAT PLE tabla 10, transcribed from perunio-frontend/src/lib/invoice-type-utils.ts, which is the list the RCE/RVIE listings are actually rendered against. IMPORTANT: this is NOT catálogo 01 and the two must not be merged. They overlap heavily but disagree — código 40 is 'Comprobante de Percepción' in catálogo 01 and 'Constancia de Depósito - IVAP' here — and each contains códigos the other does not: tabla 10 has the DUA/DSI import declarations (50, 52, 53, 54), the no-domiciliado documents (91, 96, 97, 98) and recibo por arrendamiento (10), while catálogo 01 has the electronic-emission codes 41, 42, 43, 45, 55, 56, 71 and 72. Catálogo 01 describes what may be *emitted*; this table describes what may *appear in a ledger*. Only `download` is meaningful here — nothing in this table is ever emitted, so no entry carries `emit` or `select`.
